_help: Official Links Checker. Each entry: name, category and its official domains (no www, no paths). A link matches when its address is one of these domains or a subdomain of one. Check every domain against the project's own website and verified social accounts before going live, and again from time to time: projects change domains. The result texts never say a link is safe.
source: Each project's own website, checked by hand. Verify before publishing.

match.title: Matches the official domain
match.line: This address matches the official domain we have for {name} ({domain}).

similar.title: Looks similar, be careful
similar.line: This address looks like {name} ({domain}) but is not on our list for it.

unknown.title: Not on our list
unknown.line: We do not have this address on our list. That does not make it good or bad.

always: This only compares the address. It cannot tell if a page, message or request is safe. Never type your seed phrase or private key into any website, and check a project's links from its verified accounts.

reasons.contains: The address contains "{label}" but is a different domain.
reasons.tld: Same name as {domain} but a different ending.
reasons.typo: One or two letters different from {domain}.
reasons.glyph: Uses look-alike characters (like 0 for o, or rn for m) to look like {domain}.
reasons.punycode: Uses special international characters, which can hide a look-alike address.
reasons.at: The link mentions {domain} but actually goes to {host}.
reasons.ip: The link goes to a raw number address (IP), not a named website.
